parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the storage compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and internal compartments, ensuring stability and durability of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet, designed to open and close for accessing the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the cabinet to store or retrieve items, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, allowing it to swing open and closed.
